description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dummaladeniya, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puththalam District - Cad. Map No. 410009
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (No. 64 and No. 36) with detailed property information including parcel numbers, extent, owner names, addresses, identity card numbers, title class, and any encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registration, property ownership determination, and title settlement matters.
